title: Village Nuclei Isolation With Optiprep
author: Liv Spina
materials: Gather Supplies Scalpels Glass slides 14 mL Dounce 20 µm vacuum filter Eppendorf tubes (1.5 mL and 5 mL) Eppendorf or Rainin pipette tips Dry ice Metal plate OCT (Optimal cutting temperature compound) RNAse free water Cell counting supplies (LUNA-FL) Other Reagents: PBS BSA RNAse inhibitor (i) Nuclei EZ lysis buffer (NUC201-1KT) OptiPrep Density Gradient Medium (60% Iodixanol - G60) (ab286850) Stock solutions: 500 mM tricine : 8.96 g of tricine in 100 mL water 1 M KCl : 7.45 g of KCl in 100 mL water 1 M MgCl2x6H2O : 20.3 g of MgCl2x6H2O in 100 mL water

Count the nuclei before proceeding to next steps

steps.title: Prepare Vacuum Filter
steps.instruction: Wet a 20 µm vacuum filter with 1 mL of PBSA + i.

steps.title: Harvest Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect tissue pieces on dry ice using a glass slide and scalpel.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue pieces on a boat on dry ice and hold until all tissue has been cut.
Shave off pieces of tissue with a scalpel until 50±3 mg of tissue is obtained.
Use OCT to adhere tissue to the glass slide for easier management.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using a dounce homogenizer on ice.

substeps.instruction: Transfer all tissue to a dounce filled with Nuclei EZ Lysis Buffer.
Gently dounce tissue on ice 20 times with pestle “A”, then 20 times with pestle “B” until homogenized.
Incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
If tissue is stuck to the side of the dounce, use 1 mL of reserved Nuclei EZ Lysis Buffer to wet down the side.

steps.title: Initial Pellet Collection
steps.instruction: Transfer and centrifuge the homogenized tissue.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized tissue to (3) 5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge the samples at 4℃ for 5 min (500 x g).
If filtering is performed and the filter clogs, remove unfiltered volume with a pipette, replace the filter, and continue.

steps.title: Optiprep Gradient Separation
steps.instruction: Separate nuclei using G30 (Optiprep) gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant (carefully) and resuspend each pellet in 900 µL G30. Alternatively, split pellets into (9) 1.5 mL tubes, resuspend each in 300 µL G30, then underlay each with 1 mL G30.
For 5 mL tubes, gently underlay with 3 mL G30 by placing the pipette tip at the bottom and slowly dispensing. Ensure a clear separation (cloudy on top, clear on bottom) and do not disturb the layers.
Centrifuge the samples at 4℃ for 10 min (4,255 x g). For capturing smaller cell types, spin at 8,000 x g for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Recover and Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate the nuclei pellet and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Remove the top very viscous layer (containing fats) first, then remove the rest of the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellets in 1 mL PBSA + i.
Centrifuge the samples at 4℃ for 5 min (500 x g) for a single wash.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellets in 200 - 1,000 µL of PBSA + i, depending on pellet size.

steps.title: Cryopreservation (Optional)
steps.instruction: Store nuclei if excess is available or a pause is needed.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 4℃ for 5 min (500 x g).
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the nuclei in CryoStor (CryoStor® CS10), mixing by pipetting.
Transfer the nuclei to cryotubes and store in a Mr Frosty in a -80℃ freezer until frozen (1 day).
For long term storage, transfer cryotubes to regular storage in a -80℃ freezer.

steps.title: Final Purification
steps.instruction: Perform final centrifugation and wash steps.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 4°C for 10 min (1200 x g).
Remove the supernatant and resuspend in 1 mL PBSA + i.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 4°C for 5 min (500 x g) for a single wash.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pelleted nuclei in PBSA + i.
